label: false_positive
rationale: The image (the logo inside the 'navbar-brand' link to https://mwpt.com.br/) shows the geometric icon and the wordmark 'web para todos'. The alt names the organization, 'Movimento Web para Todos', so it identifies the logo and the home link it belongs to, which is the purpose 1.1.1 requires for a functional logo image. What it adds is the word 'Logotipo SVG' and the organization's own slogan 'Construa com a gente uma internet inclusiva'. The slogan is also the home page title ('Movimento Web para Todos - Construa com a gente uma internet inclusiva') and appears next to the same icon in the footer ('Construa com a gente uma web inclusiva'). That makes the alt verbose, but it is not wrong or misleading, and it is not a filename or placeholder (F30). The suggested alt 'Movimento Web para Todos' only trims text that already passes, so this is a best-practice edit and not a 1.1.1 failure.

label: false_positive
rationale: The judgment compared the link text only with the destination's generic <title>, 'Transformação - WPT'. The destination's own heading is 'O seu site é acessível ?' and its description says 'A equipe do WPT pode te ajudar a descobrir se seu site, aplicativo, entre outros tipos de canais digitais estão acessíveis a todo mundo.' So /transformacao/ is the accessibility-testing page, and 'Teste de acessibilidade' describes it accurately. In context, the link is the only item in the footer sitemap's 'Submenu de Transformação', under the 'Transformação' section link, which also matches. The suggested text 'Transformação - WPT' would describe the page less well than the current text and would duplicate the parent link.
